content:
Jordan: Heads up — Altura Bank's prod usage is down ~62% MoM. Exec sponsor left last week, and procurement just asked Sam about pricing + a short pilot with CompetitorX :warning:
alerts-bot: [autonotice] Usage anomaly detected for account: altura-bank — 62% drop in token volume over 30 days. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/altura-usage
Priya: yikes. Did we lose any integration hooks or did their main queue error out? any logs?
Mateo: Quick query shows API calls dropped at 2026-03-05 14:00 UTC. Top lost routes: /generate-chat, /embeddings. SQL:
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls
FROM request_logs
WHERE account_id='altura-bank' AND ts > '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls DESC;
```
Lana: I can pull the webhook retry logs and confirm. Could also be a config change on their side.
Sam: I'm on it — was in touch with their procurement yesterday. They mentioned a brief POC with CompetitorX next week. I pushed back on data residency and latency but they want price parity.
Jordan: Action items proposed:
- Sam: escalate procurement convo, capture POC scope + timeline
- Lana: collect retry/failure logs + short tech note on why our latency advantage matters
- Mateo: provide a one-pager showing feature usage delta + top affected teams
- Priya: schedule a 30-min triage with Altura execs and PO
Anyone want different owners?
Sam: Ack. I'll ask for the POC spec and try to delay start until our EBR. Offering a 60-day pilot extension might help.
Priya: Can we offer a targeted credit instead of blanket discount? Need approval from finance. I'll draft the ask.
Lana: I'll attach two slides on integration reliability and a quick runbook for their infra team.
Mateo: Shared a short CSV with counts in #cs-data — will update with week-over-week numbers by EOD.
Jordan: Proposed EBR time: tomorrow 10:30 PT. @Sam @Lana @Mateo @Priya pls confirm. Prep checklist:
- customer-facing usage graph (Mateo)
- win slides + technical annex (Lana)
- commercial options (Sam)
- executive note + risk register (Priya)
Sam: Confirmed. I'll coordinate with AE and try to get their head of procurement in the EBR.
Priya: I'll loop in Legal if procurement asks for an altered MSA clause.
alerts-bot: [reminder] EBR scheduled by Jordan for 2026-03-12 17:30 UTC
Jordan: Thanks all. If we can hold the EBR and present clear root causes + a non-discount pilot extension, we have a good shot at keeping renewal on track. Will update the thread after the call. :thumbsup:
